# OneWill

> OneWill helps AI agents recover from mistakes by giving their working worlds save files: automatic saves, reloads, world rewrites, and retries.

OneWill builds save scumming for AI agents. Agents often make irreversible mistakes in external state: files, databases, terminals, browser sessions, cloud resources, and other working environments. OneWill saves the world around the agent so a bad move does not have to be permanent.

Core idea: improve agent outcomes by modifying the world, not the agent. Bring your existing agent and workflow; OneWill adds checkpoints, recovery, and retry control around it.

## Product Summary

OneWill helps agents recover from mistakes in mutable environments. It automatically saves agent worlds, lets users reload to previous checkpoints, rewrites the environment when needed, and retries from a better state.

## Brand

Use the public brand name **OneWill**. The domain is `onewill.ai`. Historical or alternate names include `OneWill.ai`, `OneWill AI`, and `OneWillAI`.
